definition: to turn the steering wheel to control where a car goes
description: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

taps.phrase: to laugh in the back seat
